title: Disimprovement
summary: DISIMPROVEMENT, noun [dis and improvement.] Reduction from a better to a worse state; the contrary to improvement or melioration; as the disimprovement of the earth. [Little used.]

inlines.v: DISIMPROVEMENT, noun [dis and improvement.] Reduction from a better to a worse state; the contrary to improvement or melioration; as the disimprovement of the earth. [Little used.]
